description: Trastuzumab emtansine is recommended, within its marketing authorisation, as an option for the adjuvant treatment of HER2-positive early breast cancer in adults who have residual invasive disease in the breast or lymph nodes after neoadjuvant taxane-based and HER2-targeted therapy. It is recommended only if the company provides trastuzumab emtansine according to the commercial arrangement.
